proposal.summary: An excessively large PDF page size can cause a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code, found via fuzz testing.
proposal.cwe_quote: can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.

A.quote: can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Determine which Xpdf versions are affected and reproduce the issue with a crafted PDF to confirm denial-of-service impact; if confirmed, develop and backport a fix that validates page size and prevents divide-by-zero.

evidence_quotes.quote: can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.

evidence_quotes.claim: Trigger context found via fuzzing and rarity
evidence_quotes.quote: found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files
This is related to CVE-2022-30524, but the problem here is caused by a very large page size, rather than by a very large character coordinate.
